condition: When startOf/endOf is called on a dayjs object converted with .tz(zone) and the range crosses a DST change, toISOString/valueOf use the original offset instead of the new one, so the instant is off by an hour.
workaround: Call .tz() again after startOf/endOf (e.g. dayjs().tz(zone).endOf('month').tz()), or parse the result of .format() with new Date(...).
